purpose: Visual study only. Reference photographs are outside Assets and are not included in the game. Existing CC0 character geometry is posed independently; no source photo is used as a game texture.

references.subject: handheld flashlight
references.observed: Four bent fingers surround the barrel; thumb opposes them near the tail; wrist continues into the palm. Adapted to the requested overhand left-hand presentation.

references.subject: shotgun stock hand
references.observed: Thumb saddles the upper stock neck, palm lies beside the stock, three fingers close below and the index has a distinct trigger pose; wrist enters from behind.

references.subject: axe handle hand
references.observed: Closed power grip, visible back of hand and knuckles, opposed thumb, and continuous wrist/forearm. Adapted to the upright carried axe.
